sessions.name: Jessica Hughes
sessions.problem:
I feel like I will never enjoy comic books again because I have not found a good series in years, leading to feelings of disappointment and loss of interest.
These feelings started around a year ago when I couldn't find any new comics that captivated me.
I believe the cause might be the lack of new superhero stories that I connect with.
The problem has progressed over time, causing me to feel less excited about reading comic books overall.
I experience these feelings when I visit the comic book store or try to read new series.
I have attempted to find new series and explore different genres, but nothing has sparked my interest.

sessions.name: Jacklyn Kirkwood
sessions.problem:
I have been feeling a sense of loneliness and isolation, especially thinking that no one will attend my funeral due to being an only child.
These feelings started a few months ago when I had a health scare and realized I had no immediate family around for support.
The stress level increased when I had to undergo a medical procedure alone, without any family to rely on.
These feelings have worsened over time, especially after a recent incident where I had to make a difficult decision on my own.
I experience these thoughts and feelings mostly at night before going to bed, and they keep me awake.
I have tried distracting myself with hobbies and reaching out to friends, but the feelings persist.

sessions.name: Trent Watson
sessions.problem:
I often freeze up in social situations, making it difficult for me to form meaningful relationships with others. This issue has been present since my college years when I was diagnosed with mild OCD. 
The stress level when the problem first occurred was moderate, triggered by the pressure to socialize in a new environment.
Over time, my social anxiety has worsened, especially in larger social gatherings.
I experience this problem whenever I attend parties or social events, leading me to doubt my ability to form lasting relationships.
I have tried exposure therapy techniques and relaxation exercises to manage my social anxiety but have not found significant relief.
